name: MC_CVG_ELIG_VERIFICATION
description: This table contains information about the eligibility verification status of coverage members.

columns.name: COVERAGE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the coverage record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: MEMBER_PAT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the member for this row.

columns.name: VERIFICATION_RECORD_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the member's eligibility verification record (VRX).

columns.name: GRACE_PERIOD_START_DATE
columns.description: This start date of the member's eligibility grace period.

columns.name: GRACE_PERIOD_END_DATE
columns.description: This end date of the member's eligibility grace period.

columns.name: MC_VERIFICATION_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The verification status type for the verification record on this line.
